name: What factors influence the cost of a site-feasibility assessment?
description: Costs depend on parcel size, topography, and whether additional technical work like boundary surveys or geotechnical soil testing is required.

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a site-feasibility assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost depends on parcel size, terrain complexity, and whether specialty tests like soil perc testing or formal land surveys are required. A basic visual review and regulatory check by a general contractor requires far less investment than full pre-construction engineering. If deep bedrock, steep slopes, or unverified utility easements require geotechnical borings or boundary surveys, those third-party fees are factored in separately. Investing in this preliminary evaluation often saves tens of thousands of dollars by uncovering hidden site prep expenses before contracts are locked in.
